methodologyNote: Unlike window.__drift3dAudioClock/window.__drift3dLifecycle (installed inside Drift3DScene, a child of the react-three-fiber Canvas, gated behind a produced frame), window.__drift3dCueResolver is installed from Drift3DCanvas.tsx, a plain React component OUTSIDE the react-three-fiber tree. It was directly readable (typeof window.__drift3dCueResolver === 'object') on the very first /drift/ load, with no fiber traversal or frame-forcing workaround needed.
